source_note: Keeper Rulebook pushed rolls allow one reroll only after a failed check when the player changes approach and the Keeper states the consequence of failure before the player confirms.
non_pushable_source_note: The rulebook removes the push option from combat rolls. It states the restriction once per combat skill in the Chapter 4 skill descriptions -- Artillery (p.71 / PDF idx 70), Dodge (p.75 / PDF idx 74), Fighting (p.76 / PDF idx 75) and Firearms (p.76 / PDF idx 75) each close their Opposing skill/Difficulty level block with 'Note: as a combat skill, this cannot be pushed.' -- and once categorically in the Chapter 6 'No Pushing Combat Rolls' sidebar (p.116 / PDF idx 115): 'There is no option to push combat rolls (either Fighting or Firearms).' Fighting and Firearms are group skills, so non_pushable_specialization_groups names the skills.json group and covers every specialization without listing all fifteen; Artillery and Dodge are standalone canonical skill names.
